Name: Magic Plushies Rayearth
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This small mod adds 3 new plushies of Hikaru, Umi and Fuu from the Magic Knight Rayearth anime to the game. I made this mod to celebrate the new remake and because I wanted to try drawing more pixel art hair :)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]1. Download.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]2. Unzip and paste in your mods folder.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]3. Open game and decorate![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Requires Furniture Framework.[/size]
